# Konsumentexperten: Så rustade är hushållen inför Black Friday

**Feed**: dagen-med-di  
**Published**: 2026-11-27  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

This Black Friday episode features Isabella Ahmadi, a consumer expert at Prisjakt, and Julia Forsberg Thålin, a consumer-stocks analyst at Dagens Industri. Household sentiment is weak: about half of consumers distrust the deals, perceived purchasing power is flat, and fewer people plan to spend during Black Week. Even so, consumption is rising and Q3 reports were fairly strong. The analyst expects a decent end to the year for many retailers and names Boozt, Clas Ohlson and the turnaround at Elon as stocks to watch, while warning that Black Friday may be levelling off and that Elon faces tougher year-on-year comparisons from next year.

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 BOOZT — Boozt | **BUY** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Guest DI analyst expects a good Black Week: strong inventory built for campaigns, a strong Q3, Denmark recovering, better momentum than last year.

#### Reasoning

Guest analyst (Julia Forsberg Thålin, DI), not the hosts. Last year's Black Week was soft and guidance was left unchanged. This year Boozt has positioned its inventory deliberately for campaign products, grew strongly in Q3 and its troubled Danish market has recovered. Boozt typically issues a post-Black Week update and guidance revision, a near-term catalyst. Macro risk remains: weak household confidence and lower planned Black Friday budgets.

#### Sell Triggers

- if the post-Black Week update is weak or guidance is not raised
- if inventory turns into heavy markdowns that hurt margins
- if Nordic consumer spending falls back

> *"Så Boozt tror jag absolut kan gå ganska bra under Black Week."*

---

### 🟠 CLAS-B — Clas Ohlson | **WATCH** (Moderate)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: ST  
**Confidence**: 60%

Fast growth, right assortment (energy-saving, Christmas lighting), easy November comparisons (+6% organic last year), but the stock has already risen sharply.

#### Reasoning

Guest DI analyst is positive on the business: growth continues regardless of Black Week, the products fit energy-price worries and Christmas demand, and November comparisons are easy, so strong November sales are likely. She also notes the share has already performed very well ('no stop'), which suggests much is priced in. Positive fundamentally, but the valuation after the run-up tempers it to watch rather than buy.

#### Sell Triggers

- if November/Q3 sales growth disappoints against easy comparisons
- if growth slows after the strong share-price run
- if the consumer weakens on energy prices or inflation

> *"Det verkar inte finnas nåt stopp för Clas Ohlsons aktie."*

---

### 🟠 ELON — Elon | **WATCH** (Weak)

**Sentiment**: Mixed | **Time Horizon**: MT  
**Confidence**: 50%

A major turnaround under a new CEO and the stock is up more than 300% YTD, but it starts from very weak levels, growth is sluggish, margins are thin and comparisons get tougher next year.

#### Reasoning

Guest DI analyst credits a real turnaround: a new CEO a year ago, franchise contracts cut, some stores run centrally, and marketing, assortment and supplier terms renegotiated. She repeatedly stresses the low starting point, still-sluggish growth and the structurally low margins of home electronics. 'Next year is the real test' against a higher base. One remark called it the 'best company on the exchange', likely referring to stock performance.

#### Sell Triggers

- if growth does not pick up next year against tougher comparisons
- if margins stall in the low-margin home-electronics market
- if franchise or store restructuring falters

> *"Nästa år är det verkliga provet när man har en annan bas och möter andra jämförelsetal."*
